events.factual_description: Blue Note New York presents Chris Dave x Meshell Ndegeocello x Eric Gales Trio from September 18 through September 20, 2026. The official event page lists two sets nightly at 8:00 PM and 10:30 PM. Blue Note identifies Dave as a percussionist, bandleader and producer with deep jazz/R&B credits, Ndegeocello as a bass player, songwriter and vocalist whose work crosses soul, R&B, jazz, hip-hop and rock, and Gales as a blues guitarist and songwriter known for stylistic reinvention. Blue Note states that tickets purchased through its official site or TicketWeb are the authorized sources.

en.why_it_matters: The interesting part is not that three recognizable names share a bill; it is that the whole setup collapses harmony, groove and distortion into three people. Dave's elastic drum language can move between hip-hop pocket and jazz displacement, Ndegeocello can make bass function as both harmonic center and melodic voice, and Gales brings a blues vocabulary heavy enough to push the trio toward something more physical than a standard jazz-club supergroup. In the Blue Note room, the friction between those three roles should be the event itself.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the six sets if New York is already part of the corridor plan, especially if bass, drums and electric guitar are a central listening thread. Three nights provide enough flexibility that I would not displace a truly scarce premiere, farewell or one-off solely for this engagement.

es.why_it_matters: Lo interesante no es que tres nombres reconocibles compartan cartel; es que todo el peso de armonía, groove y distorsión queda reducido a tres personas. Dave puede moverse entre pocket de hip-hop y desplazamiento jazzístico, Ndegeocello puede hacer que el bajo funcione al mismo tiempo como centro armónico y voz melódica, y Gales trae un lenguaje de blues suficientemente pesado para empujar al trío hacia algo más físico que un supergrupo de club convencional. En Blue Note, la fricción entre esas tres funciones debería ser el acontecimiento mismo.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los seis sets si Nueva York ya está dentro del recorrido, sobre todo si bajo, batería y guitarra eléctrica forman parte central del hilo de escucha. Las tres noches dan suficiente flexibilidad para no desplazar por esto un estreno, despedida o one-off verdaderamente escaso.
